content: Laughter is tremendous relaxation. Laughter brings you from the mind to the no-mind.
author: Osho
sourceWork: Meditation: The First and Last Freedom
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Thinking about doing something gives us a comfortable dopamine hit of progress without any of the actual friction. We often use over-researching and planning as socially acceptable disguises for fear of starting.

Osho understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Clarity follows action; it does not precede it. You cannot think your way into a new way of living—you have to act your way into a new way of understanding. The smallest real-world step beats the most brilliant theory.
reflectionPrompt: What mental clutter or unrealistic expectation can you let go of to make room for simple joy?
